newsitem.title: USA: Gateway no plans to preview Q2.
newsitem.headline: Gateway no plans to preview Q2.

text.p: Gateway 2000 Inc said it has no plans to preview its second quarter earnings at the PaineWebber conference Thursday and it will talk about its quarter, if asked, as "in like a lamb, out like a lion."

Gateway shares tumbled amid widespread market rumors that the direct maker of PCs would preview its second quarter Thursday. A spokesman said Gateway is in New York to discuss its major initiative to gain more large corporate customers.
"We will talk about it (the second quarter) if asked," said a Gateway spokesman. "It's a typical second quarter. April is always weak and May was better."

"It's a typical second quarter, which means it's in like a lamb and out like a lion," the Gateway spokesman said. He said he could not comment any further because the month of June only just started. "This is the typical seasonality that comes with the second quarter."
Gateway shares tumbled earlier on the rumors, falling to an intra-session low of 57. Its shares recovered and closed down 1-3/8 to to 60-3/4 at the end of the day.
The rumors pulled down shares of other PC stocks, with Compaq Computer Corp off 2-1/8 to 97-7/8 and Dell Computer Corp tumbling 3-3/8 to 104-3/4.
